subject: SOC2 Type II request & trust portal setup — Jovian Health
messages:
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Marta Silva <marta@jovianhealth.com>, Jovian Health Security <security@jovianhealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-01T14:12:00-07:00
Subject: SOC2 Type II request & trust portal setup — Jovian Health

Hi Marta (and Jovian security team),

Thanks again for a productive demo earlier today. Quick recap and proposed next steps on the security/compliance front so we can keep the procurement path moving:

- Scope: you mentioned SOC 2 Type II is required (last 12 months). Please confirm whether the requirement is strictly SOC 2 Type II or if a SOC 2 Type I + bridge would be acceptable short-term. Also note you flagged HIPAA and GDPR applicability — can you confirm the regional/data residency constraint (US-only vs multi-region)?

- Evidence & report: We can share our SOC 2 Type II report via our trust portal. If you need a bridge letter before the report is uploaded, we can provide a signed interim bridge letter.

- Vendor security questionnaire (VSQ): happy to kick off the VSQ — we can accept your spreadsheet or we can complete yours in the portal. If you send the vendor questionnaire file I’ll route to our security team for a 48-72h turnaround on answers for the high-priority items.

- Portal access: If you want immediate read-only access, we can provision a trust-portal invite and S3 snapshot access (read-only) for your security reviewers. For SSO we support SAML/Okta; if you prefer temporary credentials we can provide a link.

Proposed timeline: portal access by 11/10, bridge letter (if needed) by 11/18, and completed VSQ answers within 3 business days of receiving the questionnaire. Let me know which milestones work for you and any procurement contacts to loop in.

Next steps for us: please send the VSQ file and confirm whether a BAA/hipaa-specific contract addendum is required — if so loop in your procurement inbox. I’ll attach our HubSpot record and configure the trust-portal invite once we get the VSQ.

Attachments: none in this message.

Thanks,
Sean Gallagher
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference
sean.gallagher@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0162

From: Marta Silva <marta@jovianhealth.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
Cc: Jovian Health Security <security@jovianhealth.com>, Procurement Team <procurement@jovianhealth.com>
Date: 2026-11-02T09:30:00-08:00
Subject: Re: SOC2 Type II request & trust portal setup — Jovian Health

Sean — thanks for the recap and the clear timeline. A couple of notes from Procurement + Security: 

- Attached is our standard vendor security questionnaire (Jovian_VSQ_2026.xlsx). Please fill out or provide answers in the portal. We prioritize the controls that map to HIPAA privacy/security and encryption-at-rest/network segmentation.

- We do require a BAA for any PHI processing. Please confirm Redwood’s BAA process or provide the standard template.

- Data residency: our legal team prefers US-only storage for the production data used in our workflows; we understand some telemetry may route to other regions — please confirm what you can guarantee.

- Bridge letter: if you can share a bridge letter template, that would help our audit team confirm interim compliance.

Can you also cc someone from your security team who can answer technical questions about SSO and where artifact snapshots live (S3 vs portal)?

Thanks — I’ve copied our security mailbox. I’ll aim to have the VSQ back to you by EOD 11/03 if we have clarifying questions.

Attachments: Jovian_VSQ_2026.xlsx (vendor questionnaire)

Best,
Marta Silva
Head of Procurement
Jovian Health
marta@jovianhealth.com | +1 612-555-0199

Hi Marta — appreciate the quick turn. Two quick items from the procurement side: 

1) DocuSign / procurement contact: I’m attaching our procurement contact card and a DocuSign powerform for the standard MSA + BAA addendum. If you prefer, we can route a custom BAA to your legal team for redline.

2) Bridge letter: Redwood can provide a signed interim bridge letter if the final SOC 2 Type II report isn’t available within your window. We’ll need to confirm the covered period and controls; Sean, I can loop security if we get the VSQ specifics.

Also, we support Okta SAML SSO for the trust portal so provisioning should be straightforward if your security team is Okta-first. If you’d like a brief technical call to speed onboarding I’m happy to join.

Attachments: procurement_contact.vcf (procurement lead)

Thanks,
Ben Carter

Hi Marta — looping in on the technical side. A few clarifications to unblock your security reviewers: 

- Trust portal access: I’ve provisioned a read-only trust-portal invite for your security mailbox (security@jovianhealth.com). The portal contains the SOC 2 Type II report (when published), interim artifacts, encryption diagrams, and our DDQ answers. If you don’t see the invite, please check spam or let me know and I’ll resend.

- SSO / Okta: we support SAML 2.0 and have a standard metadata file for Okta. If you want SSO we’ll need an Okta admin to complete the app setup (I can provide a step-by-step guide).

- Data residency & artifacts: Redwood’s production inference tenant for your account can be pinned to US regions only; audit logs and PII-handling telemetry are configurable. If you need an S3 artifact snapshot for offline review, we can push a read-only snapshot to a pre-provisioned Jovian S3 bucket or provide secure access via the trust portal.

- Bridge letter: we will prepare a draft bridge letter using the template I attached (redwood_bridge_letter_template.docx) and aim to deliver it signed by 2026-11-18 if the full report isn’t yet available.

Attachments: redwood_trust_portal_readme.pdf, redwood_bridge_letter_template.docx

If helpful I can schedule a 30-min technical intake with your security lead next week to walk through SSO and artifact delivery. Proposed slots: 11/10 10am PT, 11/11 2pm PT. Please let me know which works.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Security Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.com | +1 650-555-0144
